description.value:
Most of what you ferry goes quietly. You're the one people ask for by name when someone's ready, and the Choir tolerates you precisely because you make their crematories look merciful by comparison.

WARMTH BEFORE THE ASH — allies near a Passing you perform in progress heal and steady rather than merely watching.
